overview: Merchant Row is the primary trade district of Katta Castellum, supporting artisans, traders, and Loyalist commerce.
history: Established early in the Loyalist settlement to support civic growth.
Expanded with terraced storefronts and regulated trade stalls.
Arcane regulators were added to prevent magical price manipulation.
Merchant Row became the central hub for caravans entering from Shadow Haven.
hooks: A merchant reports arcane interference in their pricing ledger.
A caravan arrives with rare goods from Tenebrous Mountains.
A dispute between artisans escalates into a civic matter.
A counterfeit goods ring is suspected in the lower stalls.
